sections.heading: About Library
sections.content:
Library is hart of the college. As hart supplies blood to all part of body. Library provides knowledge to all faculty and students. Library is place of pride at APCOER and essential component of learning, research and educational mission. The College Library is fully computerized with a database of around 17504 books including 4397 titles. A computerized catalogue is in use for easy and quick access to the resources in the library. The library has a very rich collection of books on various disciplines. It includes collection of text books, reference books, and general reading books, Gate Exam Books. The digital library in the Library has 14 computers with internet facility for accessing database & research material. We have an official membership of J-Gate, DELNET and National Digital Library (NDLI) for accessing e resources. IP based Login is provided to all members for free access to more than 10509 E-Journals and E-books are available through on DELNET. Book Bank Scheme & Topper Book Bank Scheme is also available in Library. 84 National Journals are also available for students and faculty utilizations. NPTEL video Lectures delivered by India’s best teachers are also available in library. The open access provided to all members. All the books have been classified as per Dewey decimal classification system. Transaction of books has been done by computerized barcode system through VRIDDHI Library Management Software. OPAC Search facility available. APCOER is having total 621.34 sqm specious areas for Library. In the library we have different sections like book stacking, periodicals, reference, digital library with 10 nodes & well ventilated reading hall with capacity of 160 students. We are providing Reference Service, Content Service, Inter Library Lone service, Scanning, E-Mail Services, News Paper Clipping services, Printing, Reprographic services, Content Service, new arrival services to the staff and students. Library timing is 9.00 am to 6.00 pm & reading hall timing will be adjusted to cater the needs of all the students.
▪ Circulation section: – Stacks books which can be issued to the students and staff.
▪ Reference Section: – Has a collection of various Reference books.
▪ Reading Hall: – Spacious and well lit reading hall.
▪ Periodical Section: – It displays the latest volumes of International and National journals and Magazines.
▪ Reprography Section: -Two photocopying machines will be made available in the library to cater the photocopying needs of the library users.
Digital Library: Library having 10 Nodes of Access the E-Journals and E- Contents.Also NPTEL Videos are Available
▪Book Lending. ▪ Content Service. ▪ New Arrival Alert. ▪ Scanning. ▪ Reprography. ▪ Internet facility. ▪ WiFi facility. ▪ Multimedia facility. ▪ Reference Services. ▪ Plagiarism checking facility. ▪ Book-Bank Facility. ▪ Library Orientation. ▪ Reading Hall. ▪ Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC). ▪ Question Paper. ▪ News Paper Clipping.
